assertions: Source-defined initialized static cache/type records and ownership in the synchronous realm-local model only

stackDivergence.rationale: Original static_types.cxx static cache cells, lazy basic/XInterface/Exception/RuntimeException bootstrap and all eight public static initializers reuse the existing shared CPPU registry, allocation, canonical prefix, completion, reference/atomic, logical LP64 layout and SAL string/expression owners. Initialized descriptions retain exact field order/defaults, static/live counts, acquired bases/members, compound offsets/parameterized flags, sequence names, enum defaults and original idempotence. Static interfaces preserve incomplete member lists and uninitialized Uik rather than invoking the distinct full interface factory. Original constexpr _ustr storage uses the actual shared OUStringLiteral owner; ASCII names use the actual original createFromAscii. The original mutex-protected repeated guard reduces to the first guard in the existing synchronous realm-local model. Stable mutable tuple cells adapt cache-cell addresses; native concurrent scheduling/mutex interleavings, pointer arithmetic/physical ABI, shutdown, malformed JS inputs, ordinary failed-producer reachability and full consumer QA remain unverified. Synthetic member alignment16 observes the selected source clamp, not an ordinary compiled ABI. Preserve original acquired uninitialized-name retention documented in CALC-047. Full unchanged native owners are rebuilt normally and under ASan/UBSan; every captured initialized field/count/name unit is compared in portable replay. No native method/body is replaced; system libraries are not instrumented and leak detection is disabled. Type/Any/Reference/default exception value and locale/case service/pool/document/view/UI remain unfinished; all broad parity flags stay false. Additional original synthetic mutable-cell observation clears the returned Exception cache cell after root bootstrap and reenters with an existing XInterface. It preserves original null return and retained static owner counts; no ordinary producer or native mutex interleaving is claimed.
